title: Application Security Engineer - Agents platform
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

  • Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

  • Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

  • Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

  • Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

  • Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

  • Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely

Requirements

  • 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

  • Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

  • Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

  • Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

  • Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

  • A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

  • Security for AI and LLM applications

  • Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

  • Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

title: Accountant
description:
At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments.

Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog, and explore our threat-hunting AI here.

As a Security Engineer, you will:

  • Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale

  • Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth

  • Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities.

  • Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents.

  • Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss.

  • Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns.

  • Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule.

  • Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too)

  • Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience.

  • Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling.

  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture.

  • Research mindset with an ability to identify novel attack vectors and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.

  • Thrives in ambiguous environments and can deliver meaningful results at a rapid pace while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration, identity and access management concepts, and security orchestration.

  • Experience with large-scale Kubernetes clusters.

  • Background in AI/ML applications for security, including experience with or interest in developing autonomous security systems.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

title: Data Platform Engineer

About the role

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.

Preferred:

Perks

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
description:
Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

description:
Overview

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Did the work within the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

â¢ Tasks are reviewed by the client before approval

title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)
description:
Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. 

 

This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence.


Some of the benefits we offer:

* Remote Work Environment

* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days

* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits

* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution

* Life and Disability

* Employee Assistance Program

* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning

* Super HAPI Fun Club


Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work.  We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

 

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

We're a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Photonic Layout Engineer to join our Photonics team and contribute to the physical design, verification and development of advanced integrated photonic devices.

You will work closely with engineers across photonic design, layout and testing, helping translate device and circuit requirements into robust, fabrication-ready layouts. The role will involve a combination of physical layout, design verification, programming and continuous improvement of our internal design workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of integrated photonics, semiconductor design and software. You should be comfortable working through complex layout challenges, interpreting design requirements and using programming to improve the speed, quality and repeatability of engineering work.

Depending on your experience, you may join at Mid or Senior level. We are particularly interested in people who have worked on integrated photonics or semiconductor IC layout, whether in industry, research or a strong academic environment.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop physical layouts for integrated photonic components, structures and larger photonic designs

  • Translate photonic device and circuit requirements into fabrication-ready layouts

  • Perform design verification, including DRC and LVS

  • Support designs through the full layout and verification process

  • Develop and improve software-based workflows for photonic layout and design automation

  • Use Python and relevant semiconductor or photonic design tools to create, manipulate and verify layouts

  • Maintain and contribute to internal component and design libraries

  • Support the development of appropriate test and characterisation structures

  • Review layouts for design integrity, fabrication constraints and potential sources of failure

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, testing and wider engineering teams

  • Contribute to improvements in layout methodology, tooling and verification processes

  • Help make photonic design workflows increasingly repeatable, reliable and efficient

Over time, you will take ownership of increasingly complex layout work, progressing from individual components and structures through to larger integrated photonic designs and full design verification.

What we're looking for

  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or another closely related technical discipline

  • Relevant experience in integrated photonics, photonic IC layout, semiconductor IC layout or design verification

  • Hands-on experience creating physical IC or photonic layouts using Python or other layout and EDA software

  • Strong programming capability, ideally with experience in Python or another relevant programming language

  • The ability to explain and discuss software or coding projects you have worked on in detail

  • A good understanding of integrated photonics or the broader semiconductor IC industry

  • Working knowledge of photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • An understanding of how physical layout decisions interact with device design, fabrication and performance

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing layouts and resolving verification issues

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs

For more experienced candidates, we would typically expect around two or more years of relevant work in integrated photonics or IC layout and verification. Candidates with particularly strong academic, research or project experience may also be considered where they can demonstrate the required practical capability.

Even better if you

  • A Master's degree or PhD in integrated photonics, photonics, electrical engineering, physics or a related discipline

  • Hands-on experience with Python-based layout automation

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor EDA tools

  • Familiarity with common integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and fabrication technologies

  • Experience developing or maintaining component or PDK libraries

  • Previous involvement in photonic or semiconductor design cycles

  • Experience working with DRC and LVS verification

  • Experience working within a commercial product development environment

  • A background in photonic device design or semiconductor process development

Relevant backgrounds could include integrated photonics design and layout teams, silicon photonics research groups, university or research institute environments, or semiconductor IC layout and verification teams.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across photonics, semiconductor engineering and software, with meaningful ownership over the quality and effectiveness of physical design.

You will join a highly collaborative engineering environment where you can influence not just individual designs, but also the methods, tools and processes used to develop advanced photonic hardware.

The role is based in the UK on a hybrid basis, with three days per week on site.

title: Coordinator, Clinical Operations
description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

Base Salary range - £35,000 - £42,000

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.
  • Processing clinician/rater forms and documenting data via status trackers and ePortal/LMS training systems.
  • Review and process submitted clinician/rater surveys and deploy applicable LMS training modules.
  • Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff
  • Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.
  • Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.
  • Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
  • Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.
  • Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.
  • Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the
    position.
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a variety of learning and development opportunities from internal and external sources focused on leadership, and professional & personal development.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About finmid

At finmid, we’re building infrastructure that integrates access to capital for SMEs directly into the platforms they use daily. We leverage technology, data, and strategic partnerships to deliver financing solutions that significantly outperform traditional financial services - offering SMEs faster, simpler, and more transparent access to funding.

As we expand across Europe, our Latvian subsidiary, licensed as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider by the Bank of Latvia, plays a critical role. Our stack combines regulated financial infrastructure with modern software engineering. The gap between those two things is exactly where this role lives.

The Role

We're looking for a Platform Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that makes everything else possible. You'll build and maintain the systems our engineering teams rely on every day — CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data tooling, AI integrations, and developer experience as a whole. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll design systems from scratch, introduce new tools, and have a direct say in how we build software.

What You Will Work On

  • Architect and manage our cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and internal platforms.

  • Evaluate, integrate, and roll out new tools and services across the company.

  • Partner with product and business teams to remove bottlenecks and ship faster.

  • Own production systems end-to-end — from design decisions to incident response.

  • Raise the bar on security, observability, and engineering standards.

What you need to be successful

We care far more about how you think than what you already know. Languages and tools can be learned — curiosity and drive can't.

  • You're a pragmatist. You find the simplest solution that actually works, not the most impressive one.

  • You're comfortable with infrastructure. You have hands-on experience with containers, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, or similar).

  • You write clean, maintainable code. We mostly work in Kotlin and TypeScript, but we won't filter you out over a language.

  • You communicate well. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people and collaborate across teams without friction.

  • You want to grow. You're not looking for a role where you do the same thing every day. You want to stretch.

Bonus points for

  • Experience with financial services, payments, or regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with managing micro-services running on JVM runtime.

  • A track record of driving projects from idea to production.

  • Experience working in distributed / remote teams.

Benefits

  • We see ourselves as “distributed first” but also have a beautiful office in Berlin where you can work.

  • We are flexible and cover whatever you need to be as productive as possible (e.g., MacOS, IntelliJ IDEA, Claude Code).

  • Home office stipend.

  • 30 days’ of time off.

  • Meaningful equity.

  • Open-minded and transparent culture that includes regular get-together meetings (e.g., All Hands, Brown Bag Lunch, Offsites).

You will work on scalable infrastructure that processes millions of daily events and ensures reliable data availability across the organization.

You'll be part of a cross-functional engineering environment collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and platform engineers. The role focuses on building reliable, scalable data systems and enabling other teams to work efficiently with data.

About the Role

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure running on AWS and Kubernetes
  • Develop and operate streaming and data platform components using technologies such as Kafka and Snowflake
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational tooling to ensure platform reliability and performance
  • Own features end-to-end, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD
  • Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to support data platform use cases
  • Contribute to improving platform reliability, automation, and engineering practices
  • Participate in on-call rotations to support the stability of the data platform

About You

  • 3+ years of experience building or operating data infrastructure or data platforms
  • Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka and data warehouses like Snowflake
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab)
  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and container platforms such as Kubernetes
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog or similar)
  • Solid programming skills in Python and interest in writing clean, maintainable code
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with technical and business stakeholders
  • Fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience with advanced SQL or data transformation tools (e.g., dbt)
  • Experience with data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark)
  • Knowledge of security and networking concepts relevant for data platforms

 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.
 
Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.
 
Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Für unseren Bereich Costing suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Analytics Engineer, der/die unsere Datenarchitektur im Bereich der direkten Kosten (Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Steuern) auf das nächste Level hebt. In dieser Schlüsselposition bist du das Bindeglied zwischen komplexen regulatorischen Anforderungen, energiewirtschaftlichen Forecasts und unserer Pricing-Strategie. Du liebst es, skalierbare Daten-Pipelines zu bauen, behältst bei wechselnden regulatorischen Vorgaben den Überblick und hast den Anspruch, unsere Systeme durch eine moderne Neuarchitektur zukunftssicher zu machen.


Deine Aufgaben:
Datenarchitektur & Pipeline Architektur
  • Du verantwortest die Neuarchitektur unserer Datenlandschaft zur Abbildung der direkten Kosten im Energievertrieb.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst robuste ETL/ELT-Pipelines mittels dbt und Airflow, um Daten aus regulatorischen Quellen, Marktdaten und internen Systemen effizient zu verarbeiten.
  • Du stellst die Datenqualität und -konsistenz sicher, die als direkte Entscheidungsgrundlage für unser Pricing dient.

    • Fachliche Konzeption & Monitoring

  • Regulatorisches Monitoring & Implementierung: Du behältst die regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Energiemarkt (wie Änderungen bei Netzentgelten, Steuern und Umlagen) aktiv im Blick und übersetzt diese eigenständig in die notwendigen Anpassungen unserer Datenmodelle und Pipelines.
  • Du entwickelst und pflegst Forecast-Modelle für unsere Kostenkomponenten und stellst sicher, dass sich regulatorische Änderungen zeitnah und präzise in den Prognosen widerspiegeln.
  • Du übersetzt komplexe energiewirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen in performante, logische Datenstrukturen.

    • Strategische Zusammenarbeit

  • Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Schnittstellen Pricing, Energy Markets (Einkauf/Forecasting) und Gross Margin Controlling.
  • Du berätst die Stakeholder bei der methodischen Weiterentwicklung der Kostenberechnung und stellst sicher, dass die analytischen Outputs direkt in die Business-Strategie einfließen.
  • Du treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung des Teams voran, indem du Best Practices in der Datenmodellierung etablierst.

    • Dein Background:
  • Du hast ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem ähnlichen quantitativen Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung (Mid-Level bis Senior) als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit.
  • Du bist ein Profi im Umgang mit SQL und Python. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit dbt und Apache Airflow in produktiven Umgebungen gesammelt.
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Datenarchitekturen und die Fähigkeit, dynamische fachliche/regulatorische Anforderungen in sauberen, wartbaren Code zu übersetzen.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, konzeptionell und findest pragmatische Lösungen für technische Herausforderungen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar – auf Deutsch und Englisch – und kannst fachliche Komplexität für Stakeholder verständlich aufbereiten.

title: Copy Editor English
description:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

  • Outstanding communication skills, a passion for explaining language conventions, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs, ideally in an editorial process, and awareness of their limitations (hallucinations, biases, outdated sources) and of legal and ethical considerations around data use and copyright

  • Structured work approach to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing weekly priorities, plan around dependencies, and keep teams informed

You enjoy:

  • Working with people from all over the world

  • Learning about every aspect of a company, from engineering to user research

  • Exploring evolving technologies and tools

  • Keeping up with the latest developments in medical language

  • Sharing ideas about language with a close-knit team

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

  • 🧠 Learning & Development (Internal & external trainings, workshops & hackathons, AI cross-talks & seminars, Blinkist access, and more…)

  • ☀️ Work From Somewhere Sunny (Access to our offices in Cagliari and Cape Town, visit the HQs, Berlin in summer)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-remote

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

AMBOSS operates across multiple international markets and diverse verticals. If this specific role doesn’t feel like the perfect match, we encourage you to browse our other open positions in Editorial and beyond to find where you can make the biggest impact.
