title: Events Auditor Associate
description:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

About the Job

We're seeking a detail-oriented and organized Events Auditing Associate to join our Finance & Accounting team! In this role, you'll support the billing and financial closeout process for familiarization (FAM) programs, as well as supplier referral invoicing. You'll also work closely with territory Events Auditors to prepare billing documentation, review program financials, and ensure accurate and timely program closeouts.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with numbers, has a strong attention to detail, and is comfortable managing multiple priorities. You'll collaborate with Event Managers, Sales Managers, Accounting, and other internal teams to track outstanding items, resolve discrepancies, and keep program financial records organized and up to date.

What You'll Be Doing

Program Reporting & Tracking

  • Maintain and update the master program closeout report throughout the day as changes are received, including new programs, outstanding items, invoices sent, and completed closeouts.

  • Utilize the master program closeout report to track familiarization program and supplier referral invoices sent to clients and suppliers throughout the closeout process.

  • Ensure program closeout reports and tracking documentation remain accurate and up to date.

Financial Reconciliation & Program Closeouts

  • Retrieve program ledger reports from financial systems as needed.

  • Review program closeout documentation against program ledgers to verify accuracy and identify discrepancies.

  • Identify and verify charges not reflected in the program ledger, including outstanding payment requests and expenses recorded in financial systems.

  • Document and flag outstanding items, discrepancies, and additional information needed to complete program closeouts.

  • Partner with Event Managers to obtain missing information and resolve outstanding items.

  • Collaborate with Accounting regarding discrepancies and necessary corrections identified within financial and payment systems.

  • Document findings and communicate outstanding items to the appropriate team members throughout the closeout process.

  • Assist territory Events Auditors with preparing final billing statements and completing closeouts for revenue-based programs as needed.

Supplier Referrals

  • Partner with Sales Managers to verify supplier referral invoice amounts.

  • Update supplier referral records once invoices are received from Accounting.

  • Update invoice statuses and mark supplier referrals as closed and invoiced once invoices are entered into the system.

  • Help ensure supplier referral records and invoicing documentation are accurate and complete.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Previous experience in administrative support, billing, bookkeeping, or a related role preferred, but not required.

  • Experience in a destination management company (DMC), venue, wedding, hotel, or events environment is a plus.

  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with spreadsheets and financial information.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to review financial information, identify discrepancies, and track outstanding items.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multiple departments.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize responsibilities, and consistently meet deadlines.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Sage Intacct, or Corpay is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate & Timely Closeouts: Assigned billing and program closeouts are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Initiative & Accountability: Demonstrates initiative in problem-solving, meets performance expectations, and takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.

  • Commitment to Access: Consistently demonstrates Access values and completes required training and certifications.

Why Access?

We’re a women-owned, award-winning destination management company with teams in cities coast to coast. For 50+ years, we’ve been producing high-impact events and experiences for global brands—and we’re just getting started.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

As a Hardware Engineer at Salience Labs, you will play a crucial role in designing and testing the electronics that power our hybrid photonic-electronic systems. As an early member of the team, you will contribute directly to our mission of bringing photonic products to high-performance compute systems, particularly those used for AI.

The role offers a varied mix of system design, PCB design, system bring-up and qualification, with a significant share of hands-on lab work at our Oxford office.

What you’ll be doing

  • Carry out detailed hardware design, including specification, simulation, schematic capture (using Altium) and component selection. PCB layout experience is a strong advantage

  • Bring up and test new hardware in the lab, focusing on the electronics and how they interact with photonic elements

  • Diagnose and resolve issues during hardware bring-up and testing

  • Characterise new electronic systems and their integration with photonic components

  • Characterise the mechanical and thermal properties of our systems and their impact on photonic performance

  • Qualify electronic systems for production, working with external test houses as needed

  • Work closely with photonics, firmware and test colleagues to turn system requirements into hardware that works first time

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in high-speed digital or analogue design, including high-speed discrete analogue-to-digital conversion, high-performance FPGAs and high-speed digital interfaces (including Ethernet and DDR)

  • 3+ years of experience bringing up and testing new electronic systems

  • Strong diagnostic skills, including hands-on rework

  • Comfort working both independently and within small, multidisciplinary teams

  • Strong technical, organisational and time management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into successful hardware implementations

  • Drive, motivation and flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment

  • Experience with PCB layout

  • Experience working with external vendors for layout, manufacturing, assembly and qualification

  • Experience characterising the mechanical and thermal properties of electronic systems

This is an "on -site" role with 4/5 days in the office required.

title: Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
description:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you’ll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You’ll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to contribute to the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will help take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Help define device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Contribute to mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Support fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: follow process flows, review process and in-line data, and help resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Contribute to the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and support design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and support the onboarding of new team members as the team grows

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 2+ years’ relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years’ hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Experience contributing to taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including exposure to qualification

  • Good understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across design, process, test and packaging functions

  • Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

  • Experience mentoring or supervising junior engineers or students

  • Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

  • Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

  • Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

  • Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

  • A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

title: HR Generalist
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As HR Generalist, you are the go-to HR contact for managers and teams in Crissier and Zurich. You turn company priorities into concrete HR actions: contract administration, onboarding, development, employee relations and compliance with Swiss employment law.

 
 

Responsibilities

Manager & Employee Partnership

  • Work in close collaboration with R&D management to support them in the design of the organization

  • Act as the single HR contact for Switzerland: present daily in Crissier, and a reliable remote partner for Zurich with regular visits

  • Give managers concrete, operational HR answers grounded in Swiss law, and address employee concerns promptly

  • Communicate with the teams with pedagogy to support and explain the organization

Stay aligned with the Paris HR team and group policy while remaining locally compliant

Local Compliance & Employment Law

  • Own compliance with Swiss employment law across the employee lifecycle (contracts, probation, working time, leave, termination) and adapt group contracts and HR policies to Swiss requirements

  • Manage relations with cantonal labor and migration authorities (Vaud and Zurich): filings, registrations, inspections

  • Handle employee representation obligations as headcount grows and keep leadership ahead of regulatory change

Payroll & Social Declarations

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle with our provider and Finance: validate variable inputs (absences, overtime, bonuses, joiners, leavers) and cross-check payslips

  • Ensure timely social and tax declarations and manage benefits (health, accident, pension)

HR Operations & Personnel Administration

  • Manage individual employee situations end to end: disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, sensitive cases

  • Handle personnel administration (contracts, amendments, files, certificates), run absences in HiBob and produce HR metrics

  • Own work permit applications (G, B,L) for foreign nationals joining Crissier and Zurich: file with the DGEM, follow up until approval, and handle related cantonal and residence formalities

Onboarding, Offboarding & Mobility

  • Work with Talent Acquisition, who own recruitment: take over once an offer is accepted and run contracts, administration and onboarding for both sites

  • Handle offboarding with correct Swiss formalities and clear handover

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's degree or equivalent in HR, law, management or a related field

  • HR Manager certificate (Certificat de Gestionnaire RH, HRSE)

  • 10+ years in generalist HR or HR Business Partner roles, ideally in an SME or scale-up

  • Strong knowledge of Swiss employment law and social insurance; experience with work permits (G, B, L) is a plus

Skills

  • Credibility with managers and engineers; able to advise and decide

  • Rigor, confidentiality, autonomy and a taste for building processes

  • Comfort with an HRIS (HiBob) and reporting tools

Languages

  • Fluent French and English; Swiss-German is an asset for Zurich

Nice to have

  • Experience in defense, aerospace or deeptech, and with multi-site teams

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Who You Are

  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets; we are building a team of top sales performers and a great winning culture, so looking for people who share the same experience and values so that together we can continue on our explosive growth
  • Able to cold call and prospect across a set territory and build a pipeline, from identifying the right opportunities to gaining access to the right levels of and across an organization; influencing and building advocacy to create the conditions for enterprise sales
  • Conduct product demonstrations in a value-based sales environment

  • An expert communicator with the ability to comfortably communicate across all levels of an organization
  • Experience hitting six-figure or seven-figure revenue targets on an annual basis
  • Able to travel for prospect meetings, based on business needs

What You'll Do

  • Take responsibility for the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting hedge funds, asset managers, investment bankers, and sell-side research departments.
  • This is a new client acquisition sales role, requiring you to research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and close sales.
  • Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet and exceed goals
  • Partner closely with our marketing team to expand brand awareness

In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

We offer a competitive benefits program, a generous commission plan with uncapped earning potential as well as equity.

$113,000—$155,000 USD

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR)

About 321

321 Aim is a pay per call Lead Exchange. Our platform, 321 AIM, delivers high quality ready to close calls and warm transfers to Accounts across multiple industries to include Insurance, Home Services, Legal and Debt Relief.

Role summary

You're the front of our sales engine. You'll start conversations with insurance agents, agencies and other lead buyers, conduct discovery, qualify them fast, and book meetings that our Account Executives can close. The SDR will have a healthy balance of outbound dialing and prebooked discovery virtual meetings. If you like the phone and virtual meetings, moving fast and want to keep score every day, this seat is for you.

What you'll do

  • Prospect into insurance agents, agencies and other lead buyers with outbound calls, virtually meetings, email, SMS and other means.
  • Follow up on inbound leads fast. Speed to lead wins deals.
  • Qualify every prospect: lines of business, current lead sources, volume needs, budget and timing.
  • Book demos and meetings for our Account Executives, and do the follow-up that gets them to show to those meetings.
  • Log every call, email, text and note into our CRM, if it's not in our CRM, it didn't happen.
  • Build and work targeted prospect lists by line of business and buyer type.
  • Learn 321 AIM and basic lead economics well enough to run a credible first conversation.
  • Hit your daily and weekly activity, booked-meeting and showed-meeting targets.
  • Feed what you hear on the phones (objections, competitors, what's landing) back to sales and marketing leadership.
  • Help test outreach into our new verticals as they come online.

What success looks like

First 7 days

Learn 321 AIM, our lines of business, our buyer types, our Lead Exchange and our CRM. Nail the pitch and the qualification criteria. Get on the phones, start live outreach and book your first meetings.

30-60 days

Hit full daily activity targets and book meetings consistently, with a healthy show rates as defined by our KPIs. The CRM records are clean and current without anyone chasing you.

60-90 days

You're fully ramped. You're following the proven process that results in a steady flow of booked and shown meetings, your AEs trust the quality of what you hand them, and the opportunities you’ve worked are turning into new accounts.

Ongoing: what we measure

  • Activity: Outbound calls, talk time
  • Meetings booked
  • Show rate (meetings that actually happen)
  • Qualified opportunities passed to AEs
  • New accounts and revenue sourced from your meetings
  • Speed to lead on inbound
  • CRM hygiene

What you bring (must-haves)

  • Experience in a phone-heavy role: SDR/BDR, inside sales, call center or another customer-facing seat.
  • You're comfortable making a high volume of calls every day and hearing "no" without slowing down.
  • Clear, confident communication on the phone, in virtual meetings, by email and by text.
  • Discipline about logging your work in a CRM, every time.
  • Competitive, coachable and motivated by hitting your numbers.
  • Quick learner who's comfortable with a CRM, learning a new platform, a dialer and email tools.

Nice-to-haves

  • Insurance experience (Medicare, home, auto, life/IUL, final expense or ACA), whether selling to agents or working as one.
  • Proven SDR/BRD success
  • Lead generation, pay-per-call or performance marketing sales experience.
  • Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.
  • Exposure to home services, legal or debt relief lead markets.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
The Technical Trainer & Writer develops and manages product training and knowledge content for a complex clinical trial technology platform. This role goes beyond technical writing. It requires understanding how functionality fits into end-user workflows and the broader content ecosystem. Technical Trainer & Writer works closely with product owners, Customer Engagement, and technical team members to ensure training and knowledge materials are accurate, well-structured, and developed to a high standard.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, job aids, user guides, and training resources alongside each of the four annual software releases.

  • Use release overviews and release notes as the source of truth so content is complete and accurate at the time of each release.

  • Write clear, precise technical documentation that translates complex functionality into language users can understand.

  • Determine where new content belongs within the knowledge base, and how functionality connects across the platform, user roles, and processes.

  • Create training assets such as training presentations, training manuals, curriculum materials, and competency assessments. These are delivered as completed assets, not presented live.

  • Work with product owners, who serve as subject matter experts, to confirm accuracy. Incorporate review feedback from product owners and the Manager, Technology Training.

  • Work with the Customer Success team to build an understanding of clinical research context and the platform.

  • Keep team templates and existing materials current with the Technology Training team.

  • Support monitoring of knowledge base effectiveness.

  • Over time, grow into e-learning development, video tutorials, and other learning formats

Role Clarifications

  • This role does not include instructor-led training, in person or virtual.

  • This role does not interact directly with external customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical training and writing or documentation experience for software or SaaS platforms, including long-form technical documentation.

  • Proven ability to translate highly technical information into clear, user-friendly content.

  • Experience with a knowledge base or content management platform such as Zendesk, Confluence, or SharePoint.

  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and the ability to learn complex software quickly.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and critical thinking. Understands context rather than only transcribing requirements.

  • Collaborative and comfortable asking subject matter experts questions, and receptive to review and feedback.

  • A disciplined self-starter who can work independently in a remote environment.

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet release deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, science, health-related, or technical communication field.

  • Experience in clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or IT industry.

  • Experience with e-learning authoring or video tutorial tools.

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
